# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Business workflow mapping and FDE delivery
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Latest Articles
- [문의폼만 받아두고 있나요? 홈페이지 문의를 CRM·알림·후속 연락까지 자동화하는 방법](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/lead-form-crm-automation/): How to turn website inquiries into a measurable sales workflow with centralized storage, routing, notifications, follow-up reminders and optional AI classification.
- [API가 없는 사내 시스템도 자동화할 수 있을까? 연결 방법 4가지](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/legacy-system-automation-without-api/): Practical ways to connect legacy ERP, groupware and admin systems without official APIs using files, read-only database access, browser automation and middleware APIs.
- [AI 자동화 상담 전에 이것부터 그려보세요: 업무 흐름 한 장 정리법](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-automation-workflow-map/): A beginner-friendly method for mapping a business process into input, processing, decision, output and exception steps before choosing automation or AI.
- [AI 자동화, 모델보다 먼저 장애를 설계해야 합니다: 재시도·폴백·SLA 운영 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-automation-reliability-sla/): A practical production guide to timeout, retry, fallback, queues, idempotency, monitoring, human escalation and internal SLA design.
- [AI 도구는 샀는데, 우리 회사 일에 누가 맞춰주나요? FDE가 필요한 이유](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/fde-ai-business-bridge/): How Forward Deployed Engineers connect real workflows, company data, AI models and production systems.
- [대시보드가 있어도 아무도 안 본다면? 데이터를 행동으로 바꾸는 자동화 설계](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/dashboard-to-action-automation/): Turning dashboards into operational systems with anomaly detection, contextual alerts, human approval and API execution.
- [매일 사이트 들어가 숫자를 옮기고 있나요? 데이터 수집 자동화의 시작](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/web-data-collection-automation/): Replacing repetitive manual copying with scheduled data collection, normalization, validation and alerts.
- [경쟁사·검색 트렌드와 우리 매출을 같이 보면 무엇이 달라질까?](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/external-market-data-sales-decision/): Combining external market signals with first-party sales, inventory and advertising data.
- [엑셀 파일이 여러 개라 매번 합치고 있나요? 자동화는 여기서 시작합니다](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/excel-files-automation-start/): Automating repeated Excel collection, normalization, merging, validation and reporting.
- [ERP·CRM·엑셀을 AI에 연결하려면, 데이터 파이프라인부터 설계해야 합니다](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-data-pipeline-erp-crm-excel/): Architecture for serving ERP, CRM, Excel and SaaS data to AI through controlled pipelines and APIs.
